title: Find provider tools beyond the first catalog page
prompt:
Fix false "Provider not found" results for providers outside the first catalog page. Evidence: src/app/providers/[id]/page.tsx:172-179 fetches the unparameterized catalog once, filters that single response by provider ID, and declares notFound when there are no matches. src/app/api/bazaar/catalog/route.ts:9 defaults to 50 rows and line 69 applies that range. README.md:33 already names 62 catalog tools. A local component execution with a full first page containing other providers made only one request and showed Provider not found.

Change only src/app/providers/[id]/page.tsx in production. Retrieve consecutive catalog pages with explicit limit and offset, collect the selected provider's tools across pages, and decide notFound only after reaching a short or empty final page. Use page length and the effective limit, not total, because the current endpoint reports the returned-page count. Preserve provider metadata, loading state, and tool rendering; stop on request errors and avoid publishing stale results after the ID changes. Do not modify the catalog API or the open catalog-hygiene PR's filtering policy.

Add tests/provider-detail-pagination.test.mjs with mocked paginated fetches and the real component. Cover a provider first appearing on page two, tools spanning pages, an exact-full final page followed by empty, and genuine absence. Run node --test tests/provider-detail-pagination.test.mjs tests/catalog-pagination.test.mjs. work on the assigned branch you are on. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflow, package.json, or auth changes.
